headline: HuyenBao v11.40 — free health (rest/self-train/7d/30d), travel feature, admin create-item-from-URL
summary: HEALTH + TRAVEL + ADMIN ITEMS. (1) HEALTH: 4 new free recovery options — Rest (+3hp, 1d cd), Self-train (+4hp, 1d cd), 7-day rest cure (+20hp, 7d cd), 30-day sabbatical (+50hp, 30d cd). No gym fee needed — low-cash players can recover. (2) TRAVEL: new feature with 7 destinations from $500 local weekend to $5M orbital space tourism. Each trip costs cash + game days, grants spirit/health/fame boosts, has per-destination cooldown. TravelSection popup in HomeTab. (3) ADMIN CREATE ITEM: new 'createItem' action in /api/admin/game — admin enters name + category + price + image URL, item is stored in custom_items SQLite table, shows in admin picker with thumbnail, can be granted to players. GET /api/admin/game now returns custom items.
